title: Pentagon officially released 'UFO' videos: BUSTED (Part 3)
summary: Thunderf00t goes through the three UFO videos released by the Pentagon and offers mundane explanations for each. He treats the footage as sensor artifacts, parallax and camera effects rather than alien craft.
why: HN commenters use it as the go-to debunking of the Navy UFO videos, though one commenter also praises it as entertaining.

quote.text: It's very informative and pretty entertaining too.
